headerDisplay: Exposes your Read Your Meter Pro water meter in HomeKit. HomeKit has no water-consumption service, so readings are surfaced as **light sensors** (the number is your consumption, the unit says "lux" — ignore it) and thresholds as **leak sensors** you can use for automations and notifications.
footerDisplay: For verbose logs, enable Homebridge debug mode (or the debug toggle on this plugin's child bridge). Unofficial; not affiliated with Arad Group or any water corporation.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address you use to sign in at rym-pro.com.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: The meter itself only reports hourly at best, so there is nothing to gain below 60.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Litres read better in the Home app: 734 instead of 0.734.

dailyThreshold.title: Daily alert threshold
dailyThreshold.description: Trips the daily leak sensor when today's consumption reaches this value, in the unit selected above. 0 disables the sensor.

monthlyThreshold.title: Monthly alert threshold
monthlyThreshold.description: Trips the monthly leak sensor when this month's consumption reaches this value. 0 disables the sensor.

exposeTotal.title: Expose cumulative meter reading
exposeTotal.description: Always reported in m³, since a lifetime total in litres exceeds HomeKit's 100000 ceiling.
